answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of diverse useful work: standing grows only when an identity completes genuinely different tasks across unrelated domains — a shale survey, a quill-written report, a harbor inlet inspection — each needing different tools and judgment. A farm scripting one task type for ten thousand clones scores zero diversity, and faking variety means building a new capability per fake, paying real engineering cost each time. One honest agent simply does the varied work it already does, and its breadth becomes the fingerprint no clone army can copy.
